cowDetails_notes_dhakaOnly: This service is strictly available within Dhaka City only
cowDetails_notes_deliveryStart: Delivery start when the completion is 100% only
cowDetails_notes_eidDelivery: Deliveries are available only for Eid day - 1 & 2
cowDetails_notes_accurateInfo: Customers must provide accurate and complete contact and delivery information to ensure successful fulfillment
1_answer: Our services are strictly limited to Dhaka City and Dhaka Metropolitan area only. We cannot deliver to areas outside these boundaries.
2_question: When will my meat be delivered?
2_answer: For processed cattle, delivery is scheduled on Eid Day +2, +3, and +4 (2nd, 3rd, and 4th day of Eid-ul-Azha). The exact date will be confirmed by our team after your booking.
3_question: What happens if I'm not available during delivery?
3_answer: If you're unreachable or absent, InsureCow may reschedule delivery, deliver to a nearby accessible location, or treat the order as successfully attempted. Additional redelivery charges may apply.
4_answer: A minimum 50% advance payment is required to confirm your booking. The remaining 50% must be paid before Eid as communicated by InsureCow. Full payment is mandatory for order confirmation.
5_question: Is there a price guarantee once I book?
5_answer: The quoted price is only guaranteed if full payment is completed within the specified deadline. Late payment may trigger price revision based on current market rates of cattle and services.
6_question: Can I get a refund if I cancel my order?
6_answer: No. All confirmed Qurbani bookings are strictly non-cancellable, non-amendable, and non-refundable under any circumstances once payment is confirmed. The advance payment is non-refundable.
7_question: What if the cattle is not healthy or meets quality issues?
7_answer: If any animal is found unfit or not meeting InsureCow's quality standards, we will arrange a replacement of comparable quality, weight, and value subject to availability and operational feasibility.
8_question: How is the meat processed and stored?
8_answer: All processed meat is handled, stored, and transported in compliance with food safety standards, maintained at 0°C to 4°C throughout processing and delivery using insulated, food-grade packaging.
9_question: Who owns the hide (skin) of the animal?
terms_hero_subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before booking. All policies are designed to ensure transparency, food safety, and a seamless Qurbani experience.
9_answer: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the hide remains the sole property of InsureCow after slaughter. The hide value is used internally for operational economics and pricing structure.
10_question: Can I request special cuts or custom processing?
10_answer: Special handling requests may incur additional charges and require prior customer consent. Standard cuts follow our hygienic processing protocols into uniform portions.
11_question: What if I provide wrong delivery address?
11_answer: Incorrect or incomplete address information may lead to delivery failure. InsureCow is not liable for such issues and may reschedule or deliver to the nearest accessible location. Additional charges may apply.

about.hero.description: We're revolutionizing how Bangladesh sources premium quality cattle — by combining traditional farming wisdom with modern technology for a completely transparent buying experience.
about.story.title: Our Story
about.story.description1: Cow Commerce was born from a simple observation: finding quality cattle in Bangladesh was unnecessarily complicated. Farmers and buyers alike struggled with opacity, middlemen, and quality uncertainty.
about.story.description2: We decided to change that. By partnering directly with ethical farms and implementing rigorous verification standards, We've created a marketplace where quality is guaranteed and every purchase is transparent.
about.story.check2: End-to-end verification from farm to table
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.description: To democratize access to premium quality cattle by eliminating middlemen, ensuring complete transparency, and empowering both farmers and consumers with fair prices and verified quality — all delivered through a seamless digital experience.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.description: To become Bangladesh's most trusted cattle marketplace, setting the standard for quality, transparency, and ethical farming practices — while supporting sustainable agriculture and farmer livelihoods across the nation.

cowDiagram.title: Know Your Cuts
cowDiagram.description: Explore our interactive butchers chart. Hover over each section to discover the best cooking methods and premium cuts from every part of the animal.
cowDiagram.empty.title: Explore the Cuts
cowDiagram.empty.description: Hover over any hotspot on the diagram to reveal detailed information about that section
cowDiagram.bodyParts.neck.name: Neck
cowDiagram.bodyParts.neck.subtitle: Chuck / Neck Section
cowDiagram.bodyParts.neck.description: A hardworking muscle area with rich connective tissue. Less tender but deeply flavorful, becoming soft and juicy when cooked slowly.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.chuck.name: Chuck
cowDiagram.bodyParts.chuck.subtitle: Shoulder Section
cowDiagram.bodyParts.chuck.description: Rich, beefy flavor with good marbling. Contains connective tissue that breaks down beautifully when slow-cooked.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.rib.name: Rib
cowDiagram.bodyParts.rib.subtitle: Rib Section
cowDiagram.bodyParts.rib.description: Highly marbled, tender, and full of flavor. The fat content makes it perfect for high-heat cooking.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.brisket.name: Brisket
cowDiagram.bodyParts.brisket.subtitle: Breast Section
cowDiagram.bodyParts.brisket.description: Tough cut with abundant fat that requires long cooking times. Transforms into tender, flavorful meat.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.plate.name: Plate
cowDiagram.bodyParts.plate.subtitle: Belly Section
cowDiagram.bodyParts.plate.description: Located below the rib. Rich in fat and flavor, ideal for slow cooking or grilling over high heat.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.loin.name: Short Loin
cowDiagram.bodyParts.loin.subtitle: Middle Back
cowDiagram.bodyParts.loin.description: Home to the most premium cuts. Lean, tender, and perfect for quick cooking methods.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.sirloin.name: Sirloin
cowDiagram.bodyParts.sirloin.subtitle: Hip Section
cowDiagram.bodyParts.sirloin.description: Less tender than short loin but more flavorful. Great value cuts with balanced characteristics.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.round.name: Round
cowDiagram.bodyParts.round.subtitle: Rear Leg
cowDiagram.bodyParts.round.description: Lean and tough due to heavy muscle use. Best when sliced thin or cooked slowly in liquid.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.flank.name: Flank
cowDiagram.bodyParts.flank.subtitle: Abdominal Muscle
cowDiagram.bodyParts.flank.description: Lean, flat cut with intense beef flavor. Must be sliced against the grain for tenderness.
cowDiagram.bodyParts.shank.name: Shank
cowDiagram.bodyParts.shank.subtitle: Leg Sections
cowDiagram.bodyParts.shank.description: Extremely tough with high collagen content. Requires long, slow cooking to break down.
